description: This file defines the NotesListFragment class for an Android app, which displays a list of notes, provides search functionality, and navigates to note details.

classes.name: NotesListFragment
classes.description: Fragment managing the display and interaction with the list of notes, including search and navigation to note details.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view, initializes UI components, and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Reloads notes when the fragment resumes.

methods.name: filterNotes
methods.description: Filters notes based on search query.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from the content provider into the local list.
